content.short: OPay is a leading African mobile money, wallet and payments platform, most prominent in Nigeria.
content.description: OPay is a leading mobile money and payments platform in Africa, serving tens of millions of consumers and merchants mainly in Nigeria. Through its app and vast agent network, users get a wallet and account for transfers, bill payments, airtime, betting and QR payments, along with debit cards and everyday banking, while businesses use OPay for payment acceptance and settlement. Backed by major global investors, OPay has become central to Nigeria's shift toward cashless payments, especially during periods of cash scarcity, offering reliable transfers and financial access to people underserved by traditional banks. By combining wallets, agent banking, cards and merchant tools at scale, it works as core everyday financial infrastructure.
